claims.claim: This package is a candidate engineering package only, not a qualified or procurement-approved product.
claims.customer_safe: Candidate only: not QPL-listed, not NAVSEA-qualified, and not an approval for procurement.

claims.claim: QPL-24441 is the governing procurement source for MIL-DTL-24441 products.
claims.customer_safe: Qualification status must be verified against QPL-24441; the DLA/QPD pages verified 2026-07-06 reported MIL-DTL-24441D, 23 part entries, and last update 27-JAN-2026.

claims.claim: Public black/yellow Formula 160/161 lineage is near 60.2% volume solids, not the 65+/-2% envelope target.
claims.customer_safe: The 65% black/yellow package is envelope-literal and materially different from public Formula 160/161; Formula 160 black full-BOM recovery remains source-conflict-held.

claims.claim: Envelope-65 is solved to 1:1 by volume, 65% volume solids, and VOC below 340 g/L with no functional zinc phosphate.
claims.customer_safe: Envelope-65 is the primary phosphate-free candidate; color pigments are identification only.

claims.claim: Enhanced-65 contains zinc phosphate and is a functional optional variant.
claims.customer_safe: Enhanced-65 must be justified by corrosion testing before zinc phosphate is retained.

claims.claim: Envelope-65 black/yellow parity remains within set tolerances for solids, VOC, density, and PVC/CPVC.
claims.customer_safe: Black/yellow twins are equal-volume color swaps and remain within the arithmetic parity bars.

claims.claim: Envelope-65 reports weight per gallon, PVC/CPVC, and stoichiometric ratio from generated arithmetic.
claims.customer_safe: WPG, PVC/CPVC, and stoichiometry are computed fields, not supplier or model claims.

claims.claim: DFT/WFT/coverage values are deterministic consequences of the 65% solids target.
claims.customer_safe: Film-build and coverage numbers are arithmetic targets that still require CRO drawdown/spray confirmation.

claims.claim: No wet-lab performance data exists for the candidate package.
claims.customer_safe: Pot life, corrosion, adhesion, sprayability, sag and shelf life remain CRO bench gates.

claims.claim: The corrosion model failed its pre-registered evidence bar.
claims.customer_safe: Corrosion is not predicted; B117/D5894/EIS/immersion testing decides.

claims.claim: The cure/pot-life model failed its pre-registered bar.
claims.customer_safe: Pot life is not predicted; the week-1 KU-vs-time screen is mandatory.

claims.claim: CRO scale ladder uses 250 g screen, 1 kg/component bench, 5 gal kit, and 50 gal pilot gates.
claims.customer_safe: Batch sizes are execution gates, not proof of scale-up success.

claims.claim: Panel prep and application controls require SSPC-SP10/NACE No.2 blast, 2.5-3.5 mil profile, soluble salts, RH, substrate temperature, and dew-point margin records.
claims.customer_safe: Surface preparation and environment are required returned-data fields.

claims.claim: Early kill gates include gel/phase split, pot life below 90 min, VOC over 340 g/L, volume solids outside 63-67%, severe sag/pinhole, failed adhesion, and early corrosion failure.
claims.customer_safe: Failed early gates stop or reformulate before paid scale-up.

claims.claim: Patent review is a preliminary claim chart, not a freedom-to-operate opinion.
claims.customer_safe: Not an FTO opinion; counsel must review claims, jurisdictions, prosecution history and equivalents.

claims.claim: Candidate sourcing has property-window grades and alternates, but domestic/TAA status and lead times are not verified.
claims.customer_safe: Sourcing is RFQ-gated; domestic/TAA and PFAS/TSCA claims require supplier declarations.

claims.claim: PFAS, TSCA inventory, domestic/TAA, and lead-time fields are unknown unless supplier declarations are obtained.
claims.customer_safe: Supplier declaration fields are rendered as unknown / RFQ required unless verified.

claims.claim: The current engine is deterministic and evidence-controlled; standards RAG, patent claim graph, process twin, and CRO Bayesian optimization are next-phase roadmap, not current capability.
claims.customer_safe: Current capability is deterministic constraint solving plus validation-card discipline; active-learning autonomy is the next engine.

claims.claim: The barrier-rank falsification protocol stores a timestamped locked-rank hash, hostile nulls, tie rule, panel count and third-party registration field.
claims.customer_safe: The locked barrier-rank protocol can lose; it is registered before panels are cut and compared against hostile nulls.

claims.claim: The CRO order includes controls, randomized panel IDs, raw returned-file paths, calibration records, and minimum panel counts.
claims.customer_safe: CRO execution requires controls, randomization, raw files, calibration records, and minimum panel counts.

claims.claim: Every BOM supplier row remains unknown/RFQ-required for PFAS, TSCA, TAA/domestic origin, lead time, SDS/TDS revision and CoA fields until declarations are attached.
claims.customer_safe: Supplier PFAS/TSCA/TAA/origin/lead-time fields stay unknown / RFQ required until declaration evidence is attached.
